titulo: [SUGGESTION] Use movie/series cover image as fallback when trailer thumbnail is unavailable
descricao:
Currently, when a trailer does not have its own thumbnail image, the trailer card is displayed without a proper cover, which negatively impacts the visual consistency of the UI.

As an improvement, the system should use the movie or series main cover image as a default fallback for trailer thumbnails when a specific trailer image is not available.

Steps:
1. Open a movie or series details page
2. Navigate to the "Trailers " section
3. See that some movies/series does not have a thumbnail image on the trailers secction, and the image is broken
comportamento_ideal: When a trailer thumbnail is unavailable, the system should automatically display the movie or series cover image as a fallback.
comportamento_atual: When the trailer thumbnail is missing, the trailer card is displayed without a proper cover image.
bdd:
Scenario: Fallback image for trailer preview
Given the user is viewing a movie or series details page
And a trailer does not have a thumbnail image
When the trailer card is displayed
Then the movie or series cover image should be used as a default fallback
